title: Highly Available Systems and Central Logging
objective: Compose load-balanced application tiers and observable log pipelines.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: High availability removes single points of failure across load balancers, applications, data, and storage. Inventory groups and tier roles make redundancy visible.
Central logging collects, parses, indexes, and searches events from every node. Automation configures both the central stack and forwarding agents, then verifies end-to-end arrival.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Compose load-balanced application tiers and observable log pipelines.
